results.fact: Itinerary day 3 / day 4 mileage vs the 16-mile high camp
results.evidence: Split out of the listed mileage contradiction: waypoints put the high camp at mile 16 and Dot at 17.6, so the hike-out (day 4, 11.2 mi) is too short and the summit day (day 3, 8 mi) too long. One trip log gives ~15.8 mi from the Lago basin back to the trailhead, supporting ~16 for the hike-out, but no source states the summit-day distance from the tarn camp, and changing day 4 alone would push the total to ~40 mi against the 35-mile totalNote/approach. Settled by a source giving the tarn-to-Dot(-Ptarmigan) round-trip distance.

Row: summit waypoint 17.6 mi, approach and descent_text ~35-36 mi round trip, itinerary 35-mile totalNote all agree on ~16-18 mi one-way; the 18-25 range is the outlier. A 2024 trip log reached a Tamarack Ridge camp at ~16 mi (via Tatoosh Buttes) and returned from the Lago basin over the Lago-Carru col in ~15.8 mi, agreeing with ~16-18 mi to the high camps and summit. No second independent one-way figure found.

The current route listing grades the climb 5.9 with P1 the crux at 5.9, and the P1 single-pitch listing (Bad-Tempered Prom Queen) is 5.9-. A detailed 2020 pitch-by-pitch report and a 2020 comment call P1 a stiff 5.8 (crux) and P6 5.8, and older descriptions gave 5.6-5.8. Sources split between 5.8+ and 5.9 with no two independent current sources agreeing; settled by a current guidebook/topo grade for P1.

results.fact: Whether a 60 m rope reaches the hidden fourth rappel anchor
results.correct_value: A single 60 m rope reaches the hidden anchor from the station above (use every station)
results.evidence: The route description says the descent (down the climb to the divergence, then five rappels) is done with a 60 m rope using every anchor station, and a 70 m only links the top two rappels. A 2020 pitch-by-pitch report says a single 60 m works and describes this exact hidden gully anchor (tree with sling to the left is the wrong one); the tight rope-end it reports is on the rappel after it, already covered by rappel 6's 'last two only just reach' warning. The '70 m with a couple of metres left' hazard contradicts both and the 30 m length, so it is replaced.

results.fact: Direction from Lake of the Woods camp to the Lake Mountain saddle
results.evidence: Lake Mountain lies about 1.5 mi NNW of Pistol Pass and a couple of miles SE of Monument Peak; a 2025 report looking north from Pistol Pass shows Lake of the Woods in the centre with Lake Mountain to the left, and a 2021 account reaches Monument's long south ridge by dropping off Lake Mountain's west side. So from the lake the saddle on Lake Mountain's south ridge and the basin beyond are northwest, matching the route's own pins (saddle ~0.6 km N / 0.8 km W of camp; summit further NW). 'South' is replaced with 'northwest' in both copies.
